slides.dek: Tenured professor. Zero publications. Infinite eyebrow.

slides.body: The owl waits four full seconds before speaking. It is not thinking. The silence is doing all of the work.
Say 'that is outside the scope of this discussion.' The owl decides the scope. Everything is outside it.
You do not need an actual counterpoint. The phrase is the counterpoint. Watch the whole room fold.
The owl rotates its head, slowly, toward whoever spoke last. Nothing follows. That person now doubts their entire education.
'As I said earlier' is a footnote, a source, and a threat. The owl never said it earlier. Nobody has ever checked.
Send this to the friend who says 'per my last message.'
